The *Uppajjatijānanapañha* ("The Question on Knowing Rebirth", Mil 3.5.9) is a dialogue within the *Milindapañha* [SuttaCentral]. Modern English translation of the text has been produced by John Kelly, and translations exist in two other languages on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
A full parallel to the discourse is preserved in the Chinese version of the Milinda inquiries, found at T 1670b 2.51 under the title *Knowledge of Rebirth* [SuttaCentral]. DharmaNexus reports no cross-language matches meeting its threshold [DharmaNexus].
